ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: no longer jealous after being given a seat
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: The colony gave {PAWN_nameDef} a seat, and no vote has gone against {PAWN_objective} since. A bedroom finer than {PAWN_possessive} own no longer upsets {PAWN_objective}.

plain.li: They gave me a seat. I've stopped counting the chairs in everyone else's room.
Someone else got the bigger room this season. I found I didn't mind.

warm.li: The colony trusted me with a seat. I'd rather spend my time on that than on envying people.

blunt.li: I've got a say now. That's what I wanted.

cheerful.li: I looked at the new bedroom down the hall today and was just glad for whoever gets it.

gloomy.li: I still notice who has what. It just doesn't bother me much anymore.

cold.li: The council treats me fairly now. I have no reason to keep comparing rooms.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: no longer jealous after promises kept to them
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: The council kept its word to {PAWN_nameDef} twice, and no vote has gone against {PAWN_objective} since. A bedroom finer than {PAWN_possessive} own no longer upsets {PAWN_objective}.

plain.li: The council said it would do something for me, and it did. Twice now.
Someone else has the better room. I can live with that.

warm.li: They kept their word to me. It's easier to be glad for others when you're treated fairly.

blunt.li: They kept their promises. I've stopped keeping score.

cheerful.li: Two promises kept in a row. I've decided to stop worrying about who has the nicest room.

gloomy.li: I expected them to forget what they promised me. They didn't, and I feel less hard done by.

cold.li: The council has been reliable with me. Envy no longer seems worth the effort.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: bloodlust fading after a long peace
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.news: {PAWN_nameDef} no longer has a taste for blood.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: A long stretch without fighting has taken the pleasure out of violence for {PAWN_nameDef}. Killing no longer lifts {PAWN_possessive} mood, and corpses bother {PAWN_objective} as they do most people.

plain.li: It's been months since the last fight. I don't miss it anymore.
I walked past the graves today and felt sad about them, which I haven't in a long time.

warm.li: I'd rather spend my days with the others than wait for the next raid.

blunt.li: I don't want to fight anymore. Good.

cheerful.li: A whole season of quiet, and I liked every day of it.

gloomy.li: I used to look forward to the raids. I'm glad that's gone.

cold.li: The fighting no longer interests me. I'll do it when I have to.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: no longer a cannibal once the famine is long past

li.thoughts: AteHumanlikeMeatDirect, AteHumanlikeMeatAsIngredient, AteHumanlikeMeatDirectCannibal, AteHumanlikeMeatAsIngredientCannibal, AteRawHumanlikeMeat, AteHumanMeat_Disapproved, AteHumanMeat_Horrible, AteHumanMeat_Abhorrent, AteHumanMeat_Preferred, AteHumanMeat_RequiredStrong, AteHumanMeat_RequiredRavenous
li.label: ate human flesh

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} has not eaten human flesh in 180 days, and the colony has not gone hungry in a long time. The taste the famine left has gone, and eating human flesh would upset {PAWN_objective} again, as it does most people.

plain.li: I don't think about that meat anymore. The famine feels like a long time ago.
Someone mentioned the hungry years at supper and I lost my appetite. That never used to happen.

warm.li: We did what we had to back then. I'm glad we don't have to anymore, and I don't want to.

blunt.li: I eat normal food now. That's the end of it.

cheerful.li: Full stores, ordinary meals, and no craving for anything else. Good.

gloomy.li: I remember what we ate. I'd rather not remember it so well.

cold.li: The craving came with the famine. The famine is over, and so is the craving.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: no longer a cannibal after taking up another faith
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.notPreceptsLabel: a faith that does not call for eating human flesh
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} has taken up a faith that does not call for eating human flesh. Without the faith behind it, the want has gone, and eating human flesh would upset {PAWN_objective} again, as it does most people.

plain.li: My new faith doesn't ask it of me, and I don't want it anymore.
I looked at the meat in the freezer today and felt nothing for it.

warm.li: The people I pray with now eat as most people do, and I'd like to share their table.

blunt.li: New faith. Ordinary food. Simple.

cheerful.li: I'm learning new prayers and new meals, and I like both.

gloomy.li: I did it because the old faith said to. I'm not sure what to think about that now.

cold.li: The preference came from the old teaching. Without the teaching it has no reason to stay.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: world weariness lifting after good years

li.any: MovingRitual, Mastered, Legendary, Freed, AddictionOvercome, Elected, TaughtWell

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Two long stretches of peace, with something good to show for them, have lifted {PAWN_nameDef}'s spirits. Bleak thoughts no longer come so easily, and {PAWN_nameDef} is easier to get close to again.

plain.li: Two quiet years in a row. I've started to make plans again.
I caught myself looking forward to the harvest.

warm.li: The people here gave me good years. I'd like to give them some back.

blunt.li: Things are better. I feel better.

cheerful.li: I laughed at a joke at supper and didn't have to try.

gloomy.li: I still expect the worst sometimes. Not every day, though.

cold.li: The last two years went well. I've adjusted my expectations.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a rebel settled by promises kept
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: The council kept its word to {PAWN_nameDef} twice and has not let {PAWN_objective} down since. {PAWN_nameDef} no longer drags {PAWN_possessive} feet when given work.

plain.li: The council did what it said it would, twice. I can work with that.
I got my work this morning and just did it.

warm.li: They kept their word to me. I'll do my part without making it hard for them.

blunt.li: They kept their promises. I'll keep mine.

cheerful.li: Two promises kept. I've stopped looking for the catch.

gloomy.li: I still don't trust them completely. But they've earned a bit.

cold.li: The council has been consistent. Resisting it no longer makes sense.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a rebel settled by a seat on the council
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: The colony gave {PAWN_nameDef} a seat and has not broken a promise to {PAWN_objective} since. {PAWN_nameDef} no longer drags {PAWN_possessive} feet when given work.

plain.li: I have a seat now. It's hard to complain about decisions I help make.
I argued for what I wanted at the meeting, and then went along with the result.

warm.li: They asked me to help run things. I want to do it well.

blunt.li: I have a say now. No need to fight the council.

cheerful.li: It turns out I like being on the inside of the decisions.

gloomy.li: Now I'm the one people grumble about. Fair enough.

cold.li: With a seat, I can change things directly. Refusing work is no longer useful.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: the urge to start fires put to use at the stove or the forge
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} has spent long hours at the stove or the forge, made fine work there, and gone a long time without a breakdown. The urge to start fires has gone, and {PAWN_nameDef} can be given firefighting again.

plain.li: I spend my days by the fire at work. I don't need to light any others.
Someone asked me to help put out a fire today, and I did.

warm.li: I'd rather use the fire to make things for everyone than worry them with it.

blunt.li: I work with fire every day. That's enough fire.

cheerful.li: My best piece came out of the forge this month. I'm proud of it.

gloomy.li: I still like watching the flames. I just don't want to start any.

cold.li: The urge has a proper outlet now. It no longer needs another.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a lush who dried out after beating an addiction
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} has fought free of an addiction and no longer wants to drink as much as before.

plain.li: I had one drink at the party and left it there.
I remember how bad it got. I don't want to go back to drinking like that.

warm.li: The others helped me through it. I'm not going to undo that.

blunt.li: I drink less now. A lot less.

cheerful.li: I remember the whole party this time, start to finish.

gloomy.li: I still want a drink some evenings. I don't have one.

cold.li: Heavy drinking cost me too much. I've stopped.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a stoner who dried out after beating an addiction
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} has fought free of an addiction and no longer wants to smoke as much as before.

plain.li: I haven't smoked in weeks. My head is clearer for it.
Someone offered me a joint today. I said no and meant it.

warm.li: I'd rather be properly awake for the people here.

blunt.li: Quit smoking. Staying quit.

cheerful.li: I get up early now, and I'm not tired by noon.

gloomy.li: It used to take the edge off. Now I just live with the edge.

cold.li: The habit was slowing my work. I've ended it.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a volatile temper softened by talking it through

li.label: talked it through with a therapist

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Regular sessions with a therapist and a long stretch without a breakdown have taken the worst of the temper out of {PAWN_nameDef}, though {PAWN_nameDef} still frays under stress.

plain.li: The therapist and I talk about what sets me off. I can see it coming now.
I got angry today and talked myself down before I broke anything.

warm.li: I owe the people here a calmer me. The sessions are helping.

blunt.li: Talking helps. I didn't expect that.

cheerful.li: Four sessions, and I haven't thrown anything in months.

gloomy.li: The anger is still there. I just know what to do with it now.

cold.li: Discussing my reactions has made them easier to control.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: nerves steadied by fights held and talking them through

li.label: talked it through with a therapist

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.newsLost: {PAWN_nameDef} is no longer {TRAIT}. The fights {PAWN_nameDef} came through, and talking them over with a therapist, have steadied {PAWN_objective}.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: After standing through fights and talking them over with a therapist, it takes more than a raid to shake {PAWN_nameDef} now.

plain.li: I talked through the last raid with the therapist. I slept fine afterward.
The alarm went and my hands stayed steady.

warm.li: Having someone to talk to after a fight makes the next one easier.

blunt.li: Talking about it helped. I'm steadier.

cheerful.li: A raid in the morning, therapy in the afternoon, and a good night's sleep.

gloomy.li: The fear is still there. It doesn't run things anymore.

cold.li: Looking at the fear closely made it smaller. A practical result.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: despair lifting with better days and talking it through

li.any: LongPeace, Married, BecameParent, RaisedChild, Freed, AddictionOvercome, MovingRitual, NursedBack, Kindness, ForgivenBy

li.label: talked it through with a therapist

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.news: {PAWN_nameDef} is no longer depressive, only a {TRAIT}.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Something good in the last stretch and regular sessions with a therapist have lifted the worst of it. {PAWN_nameDef} still expects little of the world, but good days reach {PAWN_objective} again.

plain.li: I told the therapist I'd had a good day. It was true.
Some mornings are still hard. Fewer of them, though.

warm.li: The others kept asking how I was. I've started giving them a real answer.

blunt.li: Better. Not good. Better.

cheerful.li: I enjoyed dinner tonight. I want to remember that.

gloomy.li: It's lighter than it was. I don't trust it yet.

cold.li: The sessions gave me another way to look at things. It is working, slowly.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a brighter outlook with good days and talking it through

li.any: LongPeace, Married, BecameParent, RaisedChild, Freed, AddictionOvercome, MovingRitual, NursedBack, Elected, Legendary

li.label: talked it through with a therapist

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.newsLost: {PAWN_nameDef} is no longer a {TRAIT}. A good stretch here, and talking things over with a therapist, have lifted {PAWN_objective} out of it.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: A good stretch here and regular sessions with a therapist have changed how {PAWN_nameDef} sees things.

plain.li: I've stopped expecting every season to go wrong.
I told the therapist about my plans for next year. I meant them.

warm.li: Things here are better than I let myself believe. I can see that now.

blunt.li: Life's not bad. I'll admit it.

cheerful.li: I made plans for the spring. Real ones.

gloomy.li: I still worry. I just don't assume the worst first.

cold.li: My forecasts were too negative. I've corrected them.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: feeling for others coming back after a long, decent stretch

li.events: ExecutedPrisoner, ExecutedGuest, ExecutedColonist, ExecutedPrisonerGuilty, ExecutedPrisonerInnocent, HarvestedOrgan, HarvestedOrganFromGuest, HarvestedOrganFromColonist
li.label: carried out an execution or took an organ

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} has not carried out an execution or taken an organ in 180 days, and has looked after other people several times since becoming a psychopath. Other people's suffering upsets {PAWN_objective} again, as it does most people.

plain.li: I sat with the family of the man we buried today, and I didn't have to pretend to be sad.
I thought about the executions this morning, and for the first time in a long while it bothered me.

warm.li: The people here kept treating me well when I gave them little reason to. It has made a difference.

blunt.li: I feel things again. I'm not sure I like it.

cheerful.li: Someone thanked me today and I was glad, properly glad, not just polite about it.

gloomy.li: Now I remember what I did, and it weighs on me.

cold.li: I notice other people's pain again. It makes some decisions harder than they were.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a workaholic who learned to rest
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} has spent an eighth of {PAWN_possessive} time at recreation for two months, during a long peace, and can now stop working when it is time to rest.

plain.li: I took the whole evening off and didn't think about work once.
I stopped at the usual time today and went to sit with the others.

warm.li: The others were right. I'm better company when I get some rest.

blunt.li: The work day ends at the end of the day now.

cheerful.li: I played games until late. The work will still be there tomorrow.

gloomy.li: I still feel like I should be working. I sit down anyway.

cold.li: I work better the day after a rest. I've accepted that.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a recluse who opened up to a friend
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} has a friend in the colony, and others have been good to {PAWN_objective} more than once. How many people live here no longer affects {PAWN_possessive} mood.

plain.li: I sat with my friend at supper and didn't mind the noise around us.
There are more people here than I'd like, but I know some of them now.

warm.li: Having one real friend here has made it easier to be around everyone else.

blunt.li: I've got a friend here. The crowd matters less.

cheerful.li: New people came through the gate today, and I went over to say hello.

gloomy.li: I still like a quiet corner. I just don't need one all the time.

cold.li: Some of these people have proven reliable. I can put up with more of them.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: less slothful after a stretch of work done well
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Two months with little time at recreation, and work {PAWN_pronoun} can be proud of, have got {PAWN_nameDef} moving. {PAWN_nameDef} still works slowly, but faster than before.

plain.li: I worked a full day and didn't go looking for a place to sit down.
The job took me less time than it used to.

warm.li: The others carried me for long enough. I want to do my share.

blunt.li: I work now. Slowly, but I work.

cheerful.li: I made something good this month, and I want to do it again.

gloomy.li: Lying around never made me feel better. Working sometimes does.

cold.li: Idleness was costing me more than the effort does.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a gourmand who learned to make do after going hungry

li.label: a food binge since going hungry

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} went hungry and has not had a food binge in the 60 days since. {PAWN_nameDef} no longer gets hungry so quickly, and is no more likely to go on a food binge than anyone else.

plain.li: I eat what's put in front of me now, and I'm full afterward.
I remember being hungry. Plain food doesn't bother me anymore.

warm.li: Everyone went short that season. I'd rather share what we have than wish for more.

blunt.li: Food is food. I eat it.

cheerful.li: A simple meal and a full stomach. That's a good day for me now.

gloomy.li: I still think about good food. I just don't need it the way I did.

cold.li: I eat to keep going. The rest was a habit I no longer need.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: bloodlust fading after the better part of a year at peace

li.label: a fight mark (held the line, hardened by the raids, went down and got up harder, swore vengeance)

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.news: {PAWN_nameDef} no longer has a taste for blood.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Eight months without a fight, two long stretches of peace, and time spent teaching others or being looked after by them have taken the pleasure out of violence for {PAWN_nameDef}. Killing no longer lifts {PAWN_possessive} mood, and corpses bother {PAWN_objective} as they do most people.

plain.li: It's been most of a year since I last fought. I don't miss it.
I helped bury a raider today and felt sorry for him.

warm.li: I'd rather teach the young ones a trade than teach them how to fight.

blunt.li: No more fighting for the fun of it.

cheerful.li: Another quiet season. I've come to like them.

gloomy.li: I used to wait for the raids. Now I hope they stay away.

cold.li: Violence was a habit, and I've lost it.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: less neurotic after a long calm and a long peace
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.news: {PAWN_nameDef} is no longer very neurotic, only {TRAIT}.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Three months without a breakdown, during a long peace, have eased the worst of {PAWN_nameDef}'s worrying. {PAWN_nameDef} still works quickly out of worry, but is less likely to break down than before.

plain.li: I slept through the night without going over everything that could go wrong.
It's been three months since I last fell apart. I worry less about the next time.

warm.li: The others kept things steady around me, and it helped.

blunt.li: Less worry. Same amount of work.

cheerful.li: I checked the doors only once tonight.

gloomy.li: I still worry. It doesn't take over the whole day now.

cold.li: My worrying has come down to a level I can work with.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: less anxious after holding the line
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Three months without a breakdown, and holding the line in a fight, have shown {PAWN_nameDef} that {PAWN_pronoun} can cope. {PAWN_nameDef} no longer feels on edge all the time.

plain.li: I stood my ground when the raid came. Since then the small worries seem smaller.
I went a whole day without my stomach in knots.

warm.li: I held my place next to the others, and they held theirs next to me. I feel safer here now.

blunt.li: I got through the worst of it. The rest is easier.

cheerful.li: It turns out I'm braver than I thought.

gloomy.li: Things can still go wrong. I've seen that I can handle it when they do.

cold.li: The fight showed I can function under pressure. I don't need to be on alert all the time.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: less anxious after two long peaces
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Three months without a breakdown and two long stretches of peace have let {PAWN_nameDef} settle. {PAWN_nameDef} no longer feels on edge all the time.

plain.li: Nothing bad has happened here in a long time. I've started to believe it will stay that way for a while.
I went a whole day without my stomach in knots.

warm.li: The quiet months with everyone here have done me good.

blunt.li: It's been quiet. I'm calmer.

cheerful.li: I woke up this morning looking forward to the day instead of dreading it.

gloomy.li: I still expect trouble. I just don't lie awake waiting for it.

cold.li: Two long quiet stretches are good evidence. I've stopped expecting the worst every day.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: less anxious after talking it through

li.label: talked it through with a therapist

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Three months without a breakdown and regular sessions with a therapist have let {PAWN_nameDef} settle. {PAWN_nameDef} no longer feels on edge all the time.

plain.li: The therapist and I went through what I worry about, one thing at a time. Most of it was smaller than it felt.
I went a whole day without my stomach in knots.

warm.li: It helps to have someone listen. I don't carry all of it alone now.

blunt.li: Talking helped. I'm calmer.

cheerful.li: Four sessions in, and I slept the whole night.

gloomy.li: The worries are still there. I know what to do with them now.

cold.li: Naming each worry made it easier to set aside.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: less squeamish after long hours as a doctor
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} has spent many hours as a doctor lately and has tended others thirty times or more. Blood and wounds no longer upset {PAWN_objective}.

plain.li: I stitched a deep cut today and my hands didn't shake.
Blood used to make me dizzy. Now I just get on with the work.

warm.li: Someone has to look after the hurt ones, and now I can.

blunt.li: Blood doesn't bother me anymore.

cheerful.li: I patched up three people today and kept my lunch down.

gloomy.li: I've seen enough wounds that they don't shock me now.

cold.li: An injury is a problem to fix. I treat it as one.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: less squeamish after nursing someone back to health
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} has spent many hours as a doctor lately and has nursed a patient back to health. Blood and wounds no longer upset {PAWN_objective}.

plain.li: I looked after a sick patient day after day until they were well. Somewhere along the way I stopped noticing the blood.
I cleaned and dressed a bad wound today and only thought about doing it properly.

warm.li: Seeing someone get well because I looked after them made the rest of it easy to bear.

blunt.li: Blood doesn't bother me now.

cheerful.li: My patient is up and walking, and I didn't feel faint once the whole time.

gloomy.li: After nursing someone that sick, a bit of blood is nothing.

cold.li: The sight of injury no longer affects me. That is useful.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a kleptomaniac who stopped taking after being forgiven
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Someone in the colony forgave {PAWN_nameDef}, and {PAWN_pronoun} has gone four months without a breakdown and trusts the others more than before. {PAWN_nameDef} no longer feels the urge to take things that aren't {PAWN_possessive}.

plain.li: I walked past the storeroom today and didn't think about what I could take.
I gave back the last thing I'd hidden. Nobody made a fuss.

warm.li: They forgave me when they didn't have to. I don't want to let them down again.

blunt.li: I don't take things anymore.

cheerful.li: My pockets are empty and I feel lighter for it.

gloomy.li: I still notice things lying around. I leave them where they are.

cold.li: Taking things cost me the others' trust. Having it back is worth more.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a kleptomaniac who stopped taking after being given a seat
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: The colony trusted {PAWN_nameDef} with a seat, and {PAWN_pronoun} has gone four months without a breakdown and trusts the others more than before. {PAWN_nameDef} no longer feels the urge to take things that aren't {PAWN_possessive}.

plain.li: I walked past the storeroom today and didn't think about what I could take.
They trust me with a seat. I'm not going to steal from the people who gave it to me.

warm.li: They put their trust in me. I want to deserve it.

blunt.li: I don't take things anymore.

cheerful.li: A seat on the council and empty pockets. I like how that feels.

gloomy.li: I still notice things lying around. I leave them where they are.

cold.li: A councillor caught stealing would lose the seat. Taking things is no longer worth it.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: no longer a slob after long hours of cleaning
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} has spent many hours cleaning lately, and keeping things tidy has become normal for {PAWN_objective}.

plain.li: I cleaned up after myself today without anyone asking.
I noticed the mess in my room and sorted it out before bed.

warm.li: A clean room is nicer for everyone. I see that now.

blunt.li: I clean up now. That's all.

cheerful.li: The floor is clean, the table is clean, and I did it.

gloomy.li: I spent so long scrubbing other people's mess that I stopped making my own.

cold.li: A tidy room saves time. I keep mine that way now.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: no longer a slob after taking up tidying
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: For two months {PAWN_nameDef} hasn't been able to leave a mess alone, and keeping things tidy has become normal for {PAWN_objective}.

plain.li: I wiped the table after supper without thinking about it.
I noticed the mess in my room and sorted it out before bed.

warm.li: A clean room is nicer for everyone. I see that now.

blunt.li: I clean up now. That's all.

cheerful.li: Two months of tidying, and my room has never looked better.

gloomy.li: I used to live in a mess and not notice. Now I notice everything.

cold.li: A tidy room saves time. I keep mine that way now.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: cleaner habits after long hours of cleaning
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.news: {PAWN_nameDef} is no longer a slob, only {TRAIT}.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.newsLost: {PAWN_nameDef} is no longer {TRAIT}. Many hours of cleaning lately have changed {PAWN_possessive} habits.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} has spent many hours cleaning lately, and cares more about washing and keeping things clean than before.

plain.li: I washed before supper today without anyone telling me to.
I noticed the mess in my room and sorted it out before bed.

warm.li: The others shouldn't have to put up with my dirt. I keep myself cleaner now.

blunt.li: I wash now. Regularly.

cheerful.li: A hot bath and a clean room. I could get used to this.

gloomy.li: I spent so long scrubbing other people's mess that I stopped making my own.

cold.li: Staying clean keeps me from getting sick. That's reason enough.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: cleaner habits after taking up tidying
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.news: {PAWN_nameDef} is no longer a slob, only {TRAIT}.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.newsLost: {PAWN_nameDef} is no longer {TRAIT}. Two months of tidying up have changed {PAWN_possessive} habits.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: For two months {PAWN_nameDef} hasn't been able to leave a mess alone, and {PAWN_pronoun} cares more about washing and keeping things clean than before.

plain.li: I washed before supper today without anyone telling me to.
I wiped the table after supper without thinking about it.

warm.li: The others shouldn't have to put up with my dirt. I keep myself cleaner now.

blunt.li: I wash now. Regularly.

cheerful.li: Two months of tidying, and I've started taking baths for fun.

gloomy.li: I used to live in a mess and not notice. Now I notice everything.

cold.li: Staying clean keeps me from getting sick. That's reason enough.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: no longer an animal hater after an animal bonded to them
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.news: {PAWN_nameDef} is no longer an animal hater.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: An animal has bonded to {PAWN_nameDef}, and {PAWN_pronoun} no longer minds having animals around.

plain.li: The animal follows me around all day. I've stopped trying to shoo it away.
I fed it before I fed myself this morning.

warm.li: It chose me, for some reason. I've grown fond of it.

blunt.li: One animal is fine. Maybe more than one.

cheerful.li: It sleeps at the foot of my bed now, and I don't mind at all.

gloomy.li: I didn't want an animal. Now I'd be sorry to lose it.

cold.li: It is loyal and useful. I've revised my opinion of animals.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: no longer an animal hater after taming animals
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.news: {PAWN_nameDef} is no longer an animal hater.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} has tamed three animals or more, and no longer minds having animals around.

plain.li: I tamed another one today. It took patience, and I had it.
The animals I tamed still come to me when I call them.

warm.li: They trusted me enough to come close. I'd like to keep that trust.

blunt.li: Animals are fine. I've tamed a few.

cheerful.li: Three tamed now. I'm getting good at this.

gloomy.li: I didn't expect to care about them. I do.

cold.li: Tamed animals do useful work. I've revised my opinion of them.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: no longer an animal hater after naming the animals
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.news: {PAWN_nameDef} is no longer an animal hater.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} has spent months naming the colony's animals and sitting with them, and no longer minds having them around.

plain.li: I know every animal here by name now. It's hard to dislike something you've named.
I sat with the animals after work again today.

warm.li: They know me now, and they're glad to see me.

blunt.li: The animals are all right.

cheerful.li: I gave the new calf a name today. The others say it suits her.

gloomy.li: I didn't expect to care about them. I do.

cold.li: Spending time with them made them easier to handle. I don't mind them now.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: no longer submissive after being given a seat
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: The colony gave {PAWN_nameDef} a seat, and {PAWN_pronoun} has grown more confident since. {PAWN_nameDef} no longer gives in to others so easily.

plain.li: I disagreed with someone at the meeting today and said so.
They gave me a seat, so they must want to hear what I think.

warm.li: The others trusted me with a seat. I owe them my honest opinion.

blunt.li: I say what I think now.

cheerful.li: I argued my point at the meeting and won. That was new.

gloomy.li: I used to go along with everything to keep the peace. It never made me happy.

cold.li: A seat comes with a duty to speak. I speak.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: no longer submissive after holding the line
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} has held the line in two fights and has grown more confident since. {PAWN_nameDef} no longer gives in to others so easily.

plain.li: I stood my ground against raiders twice. I can stand my ground in an argument too.
Someone tried to hand me their chores today and I said no.

warm.li: I fought next to the others as an equal. I'd like to be treated as one.

blunt.li: I don't back down anymore.

cheerful.li: I told someone they were wrong today, politely, and it went fine.

gloomy.li: I used to go along with everything to keep the peace. It never made me happy.

cold.li: I've shown I can hold a position under fire. I hold my opinions the same way.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: no longer a snob after hard times and help from others
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} has been through hard times like everyone else and has needed others to carry {PAWN_objective} to safety or nurse {PAWN_objective} back to health. {PAWN_nameDef} no longer thinks {PAWN_pronoun} is better than the people around {PAWN_objective}.

plain.li: The people I looked down on are the ones who carried me when I couldn't walk.
I ate the same plain stew as everyone else today and didn't complain.

warm.li: They looked after me when I needed it. I'm no better than any of them.

blunt.li: I was wrong about the others. Simple as that.

cheerful.li: A plain room and good company. That's enough for me now.

gloomy.li: Going hungry and being carried home cured me of thinking I was special.

cold.li: I needed help like anyone else. My opinion of myself was too high.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: no longer a couch potato after a stretch of work done well
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.news: {PAWN_nameDef} is no longer a couch potato.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Two months with little time at recreation, and work {PAWN_pronoun} can be proud of, have changed {PAWN_nameDef}'s habits. {PAWN_nameDef} no longer needs as much recreation as before.

plain.li: I spent my free hour finishing a job instead of lying down.
I didn't miss the games much this season. I was busy with better things.

warm.li: The work I did this season helped everyone. That's better than another afternoon resting.

blunt.li: Less lounging. More doing.

cheerful.li: I made something I'm proud of, and I want to make another.

gloomy.li: Resting all day never made me feel better. Working sometimes does.

cold.li: I need less rest than I thought I did.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: sleeping through the night again after a calm stretch
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Two months without a breakdown, a long peace and nights spent in bed rather than up and about have let {PAWN_nameDef} sleep properly again.

plain.li: I slept through the whole night and woke up rested.
I went to bed at the usual time and fell asleep before I could start worrying.

warm.li: It's quiet here at night now, and knowing the others are safe helps me sleep.

blunt.li: I sleep now. All night.

cheerful.li: A full night's sleep. I'd forgotten how good that feels.

gloomy.li: I still wake up sometimes. I fall asleep again now.

cold.li: A regular bedtime fixed most of it.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: mood swings settling after a long calm and a long peace
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Four months without a breakdown, during a long peace, have steadied {PAWN_nameDef}. {PAWN_nameDef}'s mood no longer jumps up and down from one day to the next.

plain.li: I felt the same in the evening as I did in the morning. That hasn't happened in a long time.
A bad thing happened today and I stayed level about it.

warm.li: The others have had a steadier version of me lately. I want to keep it that way.

blunt.li: My moods are steady now.

cheerful.li: A good week, and no crash at the end of it.

gloomy.li: I still have low days. They come and go slowly now, like everyone else's.

cold.li: My moods have become predictable. That makes planning easier.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: mood swings settling with talking it through

li.label: talked it through with a therapist

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Four months without a breakdown and regular sessions with a therapist have steadied {PAWN_nameDef}. {PAWN_nameDef}'s mood no longer jumps up and down from one day to the next.

plain.li: The therapist helped me notice when my mood starts to turn. I can slow it down now.
I felt the same in the evening as I did in the morning. That hasn't happened in a long time.

warm.li: Talking it over every week has made me easier to live with.

blunt.li: The sessions worked. My moods are steady.

cheerful.li: A good week, and no crash at the end of it.

gloomy.li: I still have low days. They come and go slowly now, like everyone else's.

cold.li: Tracking my moods with the therapist made them easier to manage.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: less impulsive after a long calm and a long peace
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Four months without a breakdown, during a long peace, have steadied {PAWN_nameDef}. {PAWN_nameDef} thinks before acting now.

plain.li: I wanted to do something stupid today. I waited, and the urge passed.
I thought it over before I answered, for once.

warm.li: The others have had to put up with my rash moments for long enough.

blunt.li: I think first now.

cheerful.li: A whole season without doing anything I regretted.

gloomy.li: The urges still come. I let them pass now.

cold.li: Acting without thinking caused me too many problems. I've stopped doing it.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: less impulsive with talking it through

li.label: talked it through with a therapist

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Four months without a breakdown and regular sessions with a therapist have steadied {PAWN_nameDef}. {PAWN_nameDef} thinks before acting now.

plain.li: The therapist taught me to count to ten before I do anything. It works.
I thought it over before I answered, for once.

warm.li: Talking it over every week has made me easier to live with.

blunt.li: I think first now.

cheerful.li: A whole season without doing anything I regretted.

gloomy.li: The urges still come. I let them pass now.

cold.li: Talking through my decisions made me slower to act, and better at it.
